checklist: Reload the page to see if the error is just a temporary glitch.
Return to a safe navigation route like the homepage or main dashboard.
Send the reference code to the tech team if the issue repeats.

checklist: Verify the backend endpoint and environment variables of the dashboard.
Check the auxiliary service before reloading the page.
Temporarily return to the overview screen if you need to continue working.

checklist: Double-check the filter, order code, or path you just accessed.
Return to the overview list to select a valid record.
If the data has been deleted, use another navigation route to continue.
missingResource.description: The data or module you are opening is no longer available at this time, so the system cannot render the detailed screen.

checklist: Reload the module to resync with the API or websocket.
Check the backend or network connection if errors appear in bulk.
Return to the main dashboard to continue unaffected tasks.

checklist: Reload the screen to try to recover the current session.
Return to the overview dashboard if you need to continue operations immediately.
